newsitem.title: UK: UK's Ofwat critical of 23 water company plans.
newsitem.headline: UK's Ofwat critical of 23 water company plans.

text.p: Britain's water industry watchdog Ofwat criticised 23 water companies on Monday for failing to submit good enough plans on how customers can make more efficient use of their water.
"Plans should demonstrate an active approach to promoting the efficient use of water by customers," said Ofwat director Ian Byatt in a statement.
This should include information on efficient domestic appliances like washing machines and avoiding burst pipes affected by frost damage.
The companies have until February 14 to re-submit their plans, said Ofwat.
Only five company's plans were deemed acceptable by Ofwat. They are Essex and Suffolk, Folkestone and Dover, Severn Trent, Thames Water Plc and Three Valleys.
